reviewedFiles.purpose: Composite action definition, inputs, and environment mapping

secretHandling.actionBehavior: The composite action maps only its token input to HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN before running brew ruby main.rb.
secretHandling.workflowBoundary: HOMEBREW_TOKEN is supplied only to the job-level prerelease-guarded bump-cask job; the workflow GITHUB_TOKEN is restricted to contents: read.

networkBehavior: main.rb calls the GitHub REST /user endpoint through Homebrew's GitHub API with the supplied Homebrew token.
main.rb can invoke brew tap, brew livecheck, and brew bump-cask-pr, which may access Homebrew/GitHub and create the cask pull request.
reviewConclusion: The reviewed composite action has no additional bundled executable scripts beyond main.rb. Its token-consuming Homebrew operations are acceptable only behind the stable published-release job guard, with the separate PAT input retained. The workflow pins the reviewed peeled commit rather than the annotated v1 tag object.
